title: Translate
description: Translate text, pictures, documents, speech and web pages into another language.

none.title: No translation engine is available
none.manager: Add a DeepL or Google Cloud key, or set up a model for Polar. Translation in the browser needs desktop Chrome.
none.reader: Ask an administrator to add a DeepL or Google Cloud key, or to set up Polar. Translation in the browser needs desktop Chrome.

temporary.notice: Temporary mode is on: nothing you translate is kept in your history.

history.title: History
history.clearQuestion: Every translation in your history is removed. This cannot be undone.

settings.title: Translate settings
settings.description: Which engines answer here, the language a translation goes into by default, and an optional length limit.
settings.orderHint: Tried from the top. Drag one to change which answers first.
settings.browserHint: Free, on the reader's device. Desktop Chrome only.
settings.localHint: Free, offline, no limits, any browser. A language downloads once from Polaris.
settings.polarHint: Uses Polar's model and counts toward its limits.
settings.deeplHint: Needs a DeepL key on the Integrations screen.
settings.googleHint: Needs a Google Cloud key on the Integrations screen.
settings.limitOn: Limit the length of one translation
settings.limitHint: Off by default, so any length is translated. Turn it on to cap one translation.
settings.limitInvalid: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.

errors.adminOnly: Only an administrator can change these settings.
errors.noEngine: No translation engine can answer. Add a DeepL or Google Cloud key, or set up Polar.
errors.noEngineReader: No translation engine is set up yet. The administrators look after that.
errors.engineUnavailable: That engine cannot answer right now.
errors.limit: You reached Polar's usage limit for now.
errors.paused: That provider is paused after a failure and is tried again shortly.
errors.pausedReader: That engine is paused for now. Try again later.
errors.failed: The translation did not come back. Try again.
errors.rate: Too many translations in a minute. Wait a moment.
errors.tooLong: That text is too long to translate at once.
errors.detectFailed: The language could not be detected.
errors.historyFailed: Your history could not be loaded.
errors.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved.
errors.statusFailed: The engines could not be checked. Translation in the browser still works.
errors.forbidden: Your role does not include Translate.
errors.overLimit: That is longer than the {limit} characters allowed here.
errors.fileTooLarge: That file is too large to read here.
errors.imageType: That file is not a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF picture.
errors.audioType: That file is not a recording this can read (WebM, Ogg, WAV, MP3 or M4A).
errors.audioTooLong: That recording is longer than 5 minutes. Trim it and try again.
errors.documentType: That file is not a document this can translate.
errors.documentFailed: The document could not be read. It may be damaged or protected.
errors.readFailed: The text could not be read. Try again.
errors.transcribeFailed: The recording could not be transcribed. Try again.

reads.imagesManager: Reading pictures needs a Polar model that can read images.
reads.imagesReader: Reading pictures is not set up here yet. The administrators look after that.
reads.audioManager: Transcribing needs a Polar model that can transcribe speech.
reads.audioReader: Transcribing is not set up here yet. The administrators look after that.

image.drop: Drop, paste or choose a picture
image.hint: Screenshots and photos, up to 8 MB.
image.altTranslated: The picture with its text translated
image.none: No text was found in this picture.

camera.hint: Point the camera at text. The translation follows every few seconds.
camera.denied: The camera could not be opened. Allow it in the browser and try again.
camera.unsupported: {surface, select, app {This app cannot open a camera.} other {This browser cannot open a camera.}}
camera.videoFailed: That video could not be played.

audio.micDenied: The microphone could not be opened. Allow it in the browser and try again.
audio.micUnsupported: {surface, select, app {This app cannot use a microphone.} other {This browser cannot use a microphone.}}
audio.empty: Choose a recording or speak, and the translation shows up here.
audio.pickSource: Choose the language you speak above to talk.

document.hint: Word, PowerPoint, Excel, PDF or text files, up to 25 MB.
document.pdfNote: A PDF comes back as text, page by page. Its layout is not kept.

input.drop: Drop the file to translate it
input.unsupported: That file cannot be translated here

website.invalid: Type a web address that starts with http or https.
website.unreachable: That page could not be reached.
website.notPage: That address is not a web page.
website.tooLarge: That page is too large to translate.
website.empty: That page has no text to translate.
website.hint: Type the address of a page to read it in another language.

glossary.title: Glossaries
glossary.description: Choose how terms are translated for each language pair, and which words are never translated.
glossary.emptyHint: A glossary sets how a term comes out, such as a product name or a phrase your team uses.
glossary.deleteQuestion: {name} and its terms are deleted for good.
glossary.keepHint: Names and brands kept exactly as written, in every language. One per line.
glossary.name: Name
glossary.makeDefault: Use for this language pair by default
glossary.imported: {count, plural, one {# term imported} other {# terms imported}}
glossary.importSkipped: {count, plural, one {# row was skipped: it was blank or too long.} other {# rows were skipped: they were blank or too long.}}
glossary.importOverflow: {count, plural, one {# term did not fit: a glossary holds {max} terms.} other {# terms did not fit: a glossary holds {max} terms.}}

errors.loadFailed: Your glossaries could not be loaded.
errors.saveFailed: The glossary could not be saved.
errors.deleteFailed: The glossary could not be deleted.
errors.limit: You have the most glossaries allowed. Delete one to add another.
errors.importEmpty: That file has no terms. Each line needs a term and its translation, separated by a comma.
errors.keepInvalid: Keep each word under 200 characters, and no more than {max} of them.
